role: Server-side debug frame annotator — draws pipeline stage overlays (detection, tracking, features, persistence, spatial, status) on camera frames and encodes to JPEG for MJPEG streams.
detail: DebugAnnotator is a stateless, thread-safe class with main entry point annotate(frame, tracked_objects, persistence_results, spatial_relations) → JPEG bytes. Decodes raw frame JPEG, renders: (1) spatial relation arrows between track centroids with teal color; (2) bounding boxes color-coded by track state (confirmed green, tentative yellow, lost red, deleted gray), with text labels for track ID/state/count and 3-color swatches at box bottom; (3) semi-transparent dark status bar at top showing frame count, timestamp, and C/T/L track counts. Helper _put_text_bg() draws text with black background for readability. Encode quality fixed at 75. All coordinate arithmetic uses integer conversion; gracefully falls back to raw frame bytes on decode/encode failure.
gotchas: No persistence result lookup or surprise flag rendering implemented yet (documented in docstring lines 12 but _draw_track() does not use persistence_results parameter). No labels drawn for track ID or state text on boxes (color swatch and thickness only indicate state). Spatial lines drawn before boxes for layering but no predicate text labels on arrows (mentioned in line 13). _put_text_bg is defined but unused.
